Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/e8mflytiz51kc4n6/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Prime Brothers [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - Wolf Prime Brothers v3.5.3 ## Intro Prime Brother Detachments are elite battle companies of superhuman warriors with highly specialized training and tactics. Stranded in the Sirius Sector, the Detachments settled a number of worlds which they have adapted to their unique needs. The Detachments changed over time as well, becoming more distinct and developing their own ideas of how best to serve their Founder. Now, Detachments struggle to maintain a sense of unity and purpose as they become more distinct. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story Following the genetic innovations of the Founder, the Battle Brothers were soon deployed to maintain unity and peace over Earth and its nearby colonies. Early space travel had proven an expensive and difficult process, and as a result, Battle Brothers were assigned to each colony as a permanent garrison. These garrisons were formed into the first Detachments, serving as their world’s first line of defence against insurgency and civil conflict. Detachments rapidly adapted to combat on their respective worlds, developing unique tactics, equipment and roles to excel in localized conflicts. By the time that the first wave of recruits had been fully trained, most Detachments had already developed their own unique culture, skills and traditions, which set them apart from the original Battle Brothers. Many Detachments became symbols of stability and cultural identity on their respective home worlds, gathering respect and political influence as their reputation grew. At the height of the Detachments’ influence, the Founder revealed his vision of a united and uplifted humanity, capable of thriving throughout the galaxy with the use of advanced gene-mods. In order to overcome political obstacles to his vision, the Founder led a daring coup to seize control of humanity’s colonies. Detachments moved quickly, with some declaring their loyalty to the Founder while others opposed him. This division sparked a long and destructive civil war which soon engulfed all of humanity. On Earth, the fighting was particularly fierce and some feared that it might leave the world uninhabitable. A portion of humanity chose to flee the situation, commandeering one of the Founder’s fleets. The Founder drew a number of Detachments from the front lines to pursue these refugees, but a massive wormhole left both fleets stranded in the Sirius Sector. The Battle Brothers moved quickly to establish themselves in the Sirius Sector, with each remaining detachment tasked with gathering their surviving members and settling on a world in order to best achieve the Founder’s vision. Their time in Sirius has given the detachments time to further specialize and hone their skills, building upon their predecessors in new ways. This has fostered a strong sense of independence and even rivalry among a number of detachments, united only by their loyalty to the original Founder and his successors, the Conduits. Fast, Fearless, Impact(9), Strider, Tough(18), Transport(6), Wolfborn | 865pts | 2 GF - Wolf Prime Brothers v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Wolfborn:When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3" of their position. ## Special Rules Counter-Attack:Strikes first when charged. Evasive:Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where all models have this rule. Melee Shrouding:Enemies get -3" movement to a min. of 6" when trying to charge units where all models have this rule. Melee Slayer:When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher. Mend:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Nimble:When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3" of their position. Piercing Assault:This model gets AP(+1) when charging. Precise:Gets +1 to hit when attacking. Rapid Rush:This model moves +6" when using Rush actions. Ravage:When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Re-Deployment:After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Re-Position Artillery:Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Retaliate:When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken. Shatter:Against units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2). Shielded:Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Surge:On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Unstoppable Mark:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply). Versatile Attack:When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. Versatile Reach:When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in it either get +4" range when shooting, or move +2" when charging. ## Aura Special Rules Bane in Melee Aura:This model and its unit get Bane in melee. Bane when Shooting Aura:This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Counter-Attack Aura:This model and its unit get Counter-Attack. Courage Aura:This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Shrouding Aura:This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rapid Rush Aura:This model and its unit get Rapid Rush. Regeneration Aura:This model and its unit get Regeneration. Versatile Reach Aura:This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. ## Army Spells **Wolf Sight (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). **Wolf Wound (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with Shatter. **Righteous Fury (2):** Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Piercing Assault once (next time the effect would apply). **Godly Thunder (2):** Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 2 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. **Wolf Dome (3):** Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). **Storm of Power (3):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Surge.
